title: pgAssistant - Executive Plan - Recommendations
description: Prioritized recommendations from all advisors, with ownership and action details.

list.name: team
list.label: Team
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT team AS __value, team AS __text FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND team IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

list.name: environment
list.label: Environment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(environment,'unknown') AS __value, coalesce(environment,'unknown') AS __text FROM pga_collection_run ORDER BY 1

list.name: target_id
list.label: Target
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT target_id AS __value, coalesce(target_name,target_id) AS __text FROM pga_collection_run WHERE coalesce(environment,'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 2

list.name: priority
list.label: Priority
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT priority AS __value, priority AS __text FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot WHERE priority IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

list.name: source
list.label: Source
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT source AS __value, source AS __text FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot WHERE source IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

list.name: category
list.label: Category
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT category_id AS __value, category_id AS __text FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot WHERE category_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

list.name: risk
list.label: Risk
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT risk_level AS __value, risk_level AS __text FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot WHERE risk_level IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (target_id) run_id FROM pga_executive_plan_snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) ORDER BY target_id,collected_at DESC) SELECT count(*) FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot x JOIN latest l USING(run_id) WHERE x.team IN (${team:sqlstring}) AND x.priority IN (${priority:sqlstring}) AND x.source IN (${source:sqlstring}) AND x.category_id IN (${category:sqlstring}) AND x.risk_level IN (${risk:sqlstring});

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (target_id) run_id FROM pga_executive_plan_snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) ORDER BY target_id,collected_at DESC) SELECT count(*) FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot x JOIN latest l USING(run_id) WHERE x.team IN (${team:sqlstring}) AND x.priority='HIGH' AND x.source IN (${source:sqlstring}) AND x.category_id IN (${category:sqlstring}) AND x.risk_level IN (${risk:sqlstring});

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (target_id) run_id FROM pga_executive_plan_snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) ORDER BY target_id,collected_at DESC) SELECT count(*) FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot x JOIN latest l USING(run_id) WHERE x.team IN (${team:sqlstring}) AND x.priority IN (${priority:sqlstring}) AND x.source IN (${source:sqlstring}) AND x.category_id IN (${category:sqlstring}) AND x.risk_level IN (${risk:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(x.effort,101)<=30 AND coalesce(x.risk_level,'') IN ('LOW','MEDIUM') AND NOT x.requires_maintenance_window AND NOT x.requires_restart;

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (target_id) run_id FROM pga_executive_plan_snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) ORDER BY target_id,collected_at DESC) SELECT count(*) FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot x JOIN latest l USING(run_id) WHERE x.team IN (${team:sqlstring}) AND x.priority IN (${priority:sqlstring}) AND x.source IN (${source:sqlstring}) AND x.category_id IN (${category:sqlstring}) AND x.risk_level IN (${risk:sqlstring}) AND x.requires_lock;

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (target_id) run_id FROM pga_executive_plan_snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) ORDER BY target_id,collected_at DESC) SELECT count(*) FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot x JOIN latest l USING(run_id) WHERE x.team IN (${team:sqlstring}) AND x.priority IN (${priority:sqlstring}) AND x.source IN (${source:sqlstring}) AND x.category_id IN (${category:sqlstring}) AND x.risk_level IN (${risk:sqlstring}) AND x.requires_maintenance_window;

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (target_id) run_id FROM pga_executive_plan_snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) ORDER BY target_id,collected_at DESC) SELECT count(*) FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot x JOIN latest l USING(run_id) WHERE x.team IN (${team:sqlstring}) AND x.priority IN (${priority:sqlstring}) AND x.source IN (${source:sqlstring}) AND x.category_id IN (${category:sqlstring}) AND x.risk_level IN (${risk:sqlstring}) AND x.requires_restart;

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (target_id) run_id FROM pga_executive_plan_snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) ORDER BY target_id,collected_at DESC) SELECT x.source,count(*) AS recommendations FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot x JOIN latest l USING(run_id) WHERE x.team IN (${team:sqlstring}) AND x.priority IN (${priority:sqlstring}) AND x.source IN (${source:sqlstring}) AND x.category_id IN (${category:sqlstring}) AND x.risk_level IN (${risk:sqlstring}) GROUP BY x.source ORDER BY 2 DESC;

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (target_id) run_id FROM pga_executive_plan_snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) ORDER BY target_id,collected_at DESC) SELECT x.category_id,count(*) AS recommendations FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot x JOIN latest l USING(run_id) WHERE x.team IN (${team:sqlstring}) AND x.priority IN (${priority:sqlstring}) AND x.source IN (${source:sqlstring}) AND x.category_id IN (${category:sqlstring}) AND x.risk_level IN (${risk:sqlstring}) GROUP BY x.category_id ORDER BY 2 DESC;

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.target_id) p.run_id,p.target_id,p.collected_at FROM pga_executive_plan_snapshot p JOIN pga_collection_run r ON r.run_id=p.run_id WHERE $__timeFilter(p.collected_at) AND p.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(r.environment,'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring}) ORDER BY p.target_id,p.collected_at DESC) SELECT l.target_id,x.team,x.priority,x.source,x.category_id,x.action_type,x.risk_level,x.impact,x.confidence,x.effort,x.scope_name,x.title,x.requires_lock,x.requires_maintenance_window,x.requires_restart,x.recommendation_sql FROM latest l JOIN pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot x USING(run_id) WHERE x.team IN (${team:sqlstring}) AND x.priority IN (${priority:sqlstring}) AND x.source IN (${source:sqlstring}) AND x.category_id IN (${category:sqlstring}) AND x.risk_level IN (${risk:sqlstring}) ORDER BY CASE x.priority WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 1 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LOW' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END,x.impact DESC NULLS LAST,x.confidence DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 500;
